fact: Articles 30 and 31 of Law No. 005 of 2023 bar a data controller from transferring personal data outside Somalia unless the recipient country, organisation or sector gives adequate protection, the recipient is bound by a law, binding corporate rules or contractual clauses giving it, or a stated exception such as the person's consent or a contract applies; the law takes effect on adoption by Parliament, promulgation by the President and publication in the Official Bulletin, and the document's date is the presidential signature date, taken as a proxy.
system: Data Protection Act (Law No. 005 of 2023), Articles 30-31

fact: Somali civil society (SONSA) issued a position on 20 July 2026 calling on the federal government, the NCA and the Data Protection Authority to sign the Malabo Convention, ratify it and deposit the instrument, so that Somalia can become a State Party; the document says Somalia is not yet one.

The African Union Commission's status list of 2 February 2026 shows Somalia (no. 45) with no date of signature, ratification or deposit for the Malabo Convention, which it says entered into force on 8 June 2023 and has 21 signatures and 20 ratifications among 55 states.
system: African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection
